text: Released v0.114.17: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v0.114.17 . What's in it: (1) the app can't show stale data: red banner and grey tiles when it can't reach GitHub, 'Engine quiet' amber at 30 s, 'Stalled' when a scan hasn't moved 90 s, and old-price bets move into 'Show old bets'; (2) status read every 2 s + a LIVE (direct) chip once the engine is up with its tunnel; (3) the Engine tab Address tile shows the real Novig verdict; (4) Run now / Stop now fixes: Stop lasts until the next 8am ET opening; (5) the engine auto-resumes at 8am after you turn it off (not after STOP ALL). The engine itself is stopped until 8am ET; at 8:03 I verify it came up and that the tunnel/LIVE chip works.
